senses.sense_definition: Het vergroten van de kennis en vaardigheden van professionals die hun opleiding al hebben afgerond

examples.text: De school investeert dit jaar extra in de <w>deskundigheidsbevordering</w> van haar docenten.

target_lang_translations.en: The school is investing extra this year in the <w>professional development</w> of its teachers.

examples.text: Voor deze functie is voortdurende <w>deskundigheidsbevordering</w> een vereiste om op de hoogte te blijven van nieuwe wetgeving.

target_lang_translations.en: For this position, continuous <w>professional development</w> is a requirement to stay informed about new legislation.

target_lang_definitions.en: Increasing the knowledge and skills of professionals who have already completed their formal education

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: activities that develop an individual's skills, knowledge, and expertise as a professional
the process of enhancing specialized knowledge and skills in a specific field
additional education or training to improve professional skills
